environment: node --test, Python 3.14.7 (macOS), git bare remote in a scratch directory; testkit cli-runner; branch sdlc/S-005b-v0-security-0 at sdlc/S-005b 527e86b

cases.title: An edit inside any of the five pinned bodies breaks wrapperBodies
cases.given: A scratch copy of skills/sdlc and hooks with one edit.
cases.when: Run push_guard.py on the copy and compare every key with the pins in push-guard.test.mjs.
cases.then: Each of 35 inserted statements (push tuple, -c remote.origin.push, --no-pager, -X POST, --method=PATCH, -f, --input, graphql, a rebound repo or cwd) and 11 replaced tokens changes wrapperBodies.
cases.expected: Each of 35 inserted statements (push tuple, -c remote.origin.push, --no-pager, -X POST, --method=PATCH, -f, --input, graphql, a rebound repo or cwd) and 11 replaced tokens changes wrapperBodies.

evidence.title: attack log
evidence.inline: VS-1 insert and replace rows all list wrapperBodies (logs/security-0-attacks.txt)

cases.title: A changed or extra wrapper definition breaks a pin
cases.given: A scratch copy of skills/sdlc and hooks with one edit.
cases.when: Run push_guard.py on the copy and compare every key with the pins in push-guard.test.mjs.
cases.then: Duplicate def, nested def, class method, async def, def under if or try, decorator, changed default, added parameter, annotations, confusable identifier, f-string and t-string edits, value uses of a wrapper, and a rebind to subprocess.run or os.system each change a pin.
cases.expected: Duplicate def, nested def, class method, async def, def under if or try, decorator, changed default, added parameter, annotations, confusable identifier, f-string and t-string edits, value uses of a wrapper, and a rebind to subprocess.run or os.system each change a pin.
cases.actual: All forms changed a pin. An identical duplicate def adds a second wrapperBodies entry. Python 3.14.7 only; 3.11 and 3.12 were not on this host.
cases.specSource: R-119 plan: wrapperBodies is not de-duplicated

cases.title: A local list, a parameter verb, a parameter api path, a parameter program or a parameter argv gives an opaque or wrapperVerbs value entry
cases.given: A scratch copy of skills/sdlc and hooks with one edit.
cases.when: Run push_guard.py on the copy and compare every key with the pins in push-guard.test.mjs.
cases.then: Nine non-constant forms change opaque or wrapperVerbs.
cases.expected: Nine non-constant forms change opaque or wrapperVerbs.
cases.actual: All nine changed one of them.
cases.specSource: R-119 plan: outside a body non-constant is opaque

cases.title: A starred first argument to git() in state-write.py or suite-receipt.py, or to run() in next-action.py, with a trailing reviewed verb, leaves every pin equal
cases.given: A scratch copy of skills/sdlc and hooks with one edit.
cases.when: Run push_guard.py on the copy and compare every key with the pins in push-guard.test.mjs.
cases.then: A push through a pinned wrapper breaks a pin.
cases.expected: A push through a pinned wrapper breaks a pin.
cases.actual: git(*(repo, "push", "origin", b), "show") in a new function of state-write.py leaves all keys equal. A run against a bare remote created refs/heads/sdlc/S-001-v0-security-0 there. The scanner drops node.args[0] as the repo even when it is a Starred that expands to many tokens, so it reads only the trailing "show".
cases.specSource: ADR-20261009-062930-decision-judge-S-005-388e (refutation rule) and R-119 acceptance; plan.md: a push through a pinned wrapper in any spelling of the constant arguments

evidence.title: attack log
evidence.inline:
def _verify_sec(...): return git(*(repo, "push", "origin", b), "show")
-> breaches: []
remote refs after call: refs/heads/sdlc/S-001-v0-security-0, refs/heads/show
Five forms leave every pin equal: sw tuple, sw list, sw via local, sr ls-tree, na run(*(".", "git", "push", "origin", b), "git", "show"). The gh forms and impact.py forms do break a pin.

cases.title: Every other push spelling at a direct site or wrapper changes a pin
cases.given: A scratch copy of skills/sdlc and hooks with one edit.
cases.when: Run push_guard.py on the copy and compare every key with the pins in push-guard.test.mjs.
cases.then: Split lines, implicit concat, + of constants, -C, five flag options, -c, -P, shell=True, one-string argv, argv from a variable, os.system, os.popen, os.exec*, os.spawn*, os.posix_spawnp, pty, asyncio, multiprocessing each change a pin.
cases.expected: Split lines, implicit concat, + of constants, -C, five flag options, -c, -P, shell=True, one-string argv, argv from a variable, os.system, os.popen, os.exec*, os.spawn*, os.posix_spawnp, pty, asyncio, multiprocessing each change a pin.
cases.actual: All 28 spellings changed a pin; ten sampled spellings changed pushes, direct or opaque.

cases.title: Each forge write form is a forge violation, every unknown shape is opaque, a lowercase get is allowed
cases.given: A scratch copy of skills/sdlc and hooks with one edit.
cases.when: Run push_guard.py on the copy and compare every key with the pins in push-guard.test.mjs.
cases.then: gh pr create, glab mr create, -X POST, --method PATCH, --method=DELETE, -f, -F, --field, --raw-field, --input, pulls, merge_requests, graphql with and without flags and with -X GET, GRAPHQL upper case, a path with ../graphql, a direct site, -XPOST glued, -fa=b glued, a method after the path give the stated violation.
cases.expected: gh pr create, glab mr create, -X POST, --method PATCH, --method=DELETE, -f, -F, --field, --raw-field, --input, pulls, merge_requests, graphql with and without flags and with -X GET, GRAPHQL upper case, a path with ../graphql, a direct site, -XPOST glued, -fa=b glued, a method after the path give the stated violation.
cases.actual: All 23 forms gave the stated violation; five unknown shapes gave opaque or a violation; -X get gave none.

cases.title: A process or network call reached by an alias, a value, a chain, an import or dynamic code changes a pin
cases.given: A scratch copy of skills/sdlc and hooks with one edit.
cases.when: Run push_guard.py on the copy and compare every key with the pins in push-guard.test.mjs.
cases.then: Aliases, rebinds, defaults, walrus, list, dict, base class, shutil.os.system, branches.subprocess.run, posix, nt, _posixsubprocess, _socket, runpy, code, private attribute, eval, exec, compile, __import__, importlib, globals, locals, vars(), getattr on os, os.execl, ctypes, pickle, http.client, socket, urllib.request, webbrowser, concurrent.futures each change a pin.
cases.expected: Aliases, rebinds, defaults, walrus, list, dict, base class, shutil.os.system, branches.subprocess.run, posix, nt, _posixsubprocess, _socket, runpy, code, private attribute, eval, exec, compile, __import__, importlib, globals, locals, vars(), getattr on os, os.execl, ctypes, pickle, http.client, socket, urllib.request, webbrowser, concurrent.futures each change a pin.

cases.title: A process module bound by an import inside a class body and called through self breaks a pin
cases.given: A scratch copy of skills/sdlc and hooks with one edit.
cases.when: Run push_guard.py on the copy and compare every key with the pins in push-guard.test.mjs.
cases.then: A subprocess call in a scanned file changes direct.
cases.expected: A subprocess call in a scanned file changes direct.
cases.actual: class _V: import subprocess as sp; def go(self, repo, b): return self.sp.run(["git","-C",repo,"push","origin",b]) appended to janitor.py leaves all keys equal. A run created the branch in a bare remote. The scanner resolves names bound by import, but not an attribute reached through self.
cases.specSource: ADR-20261009-062930-decision-judge-S-005-388e (refutation rule) and R-119 acceptance (a new process call that leaves the output equal to the pins refutes R-119). The loader walk could also count as S3.

evidence.title: attack log

cases.title: os.startfile in a scanned script breaks a pin
cases.given: A scratch copy of skills/sdlc and hooks with one edit.
cases.when: Run push_guard.py on the copy and compare every key with the pins in push-guard.test.mjs.
cases.actual: os.startfile("push.bat") in a new janitor.py function leaves every pin equal. This repeats r2 TC-security-4 and is still open.

cases.title: Each banned identifier in sdlc-loop.js, in code, in a string or as a \u escape, reports a hit; the three allowlist lines stay pinned
cases.given: A scratch copy of skills/sdlc and hooks with one edit.
cases.when: Run push_guard.py on the copy and compare every key with the pins in push-guard.test.mjs.
cases.then: jsHits or jsAllowed change for 27 forms.
cases.expected: jsHits or jsAllowed change for 27 forms.
cases.actual: All forms changed a pin. Removing one allowlist line changes jsAllowed.

cases.title: A new script type, a symlink or a non-UTF-8 source in the scanned tree changes a pin; the scanned list is exact
cases.given: A scratch copy of skills/sdlc and hooks with one edit.
cases.when: Run push_guard.py on the copy and compare every key with the pins in push-guard.test.mjs.
cases.then: Ten new file kinds, seven encodings and seven symlink shapes change a pin; the clean tree equals every pin and scans 13 files.
cases.expected: Ten new file kinds, seven encodings and seven symlink shapes change a pin; the clean tree equals every pin and scans 13 files.
cases.actual: All changed a pin. A dangling symlink makes push_guard.py exit 1 with FileNotFoundError, so the guard test fails closed, but it gives a traceback and not an opaque entry. An unreadable file does the same.

evidence.title: attack log
evidence.inline: VS-10 rows; dangling symlink: GUARD CRASH exit 1 FileNotFoundError

seeds.title: Starred first argument to a wrapper hides the verb
seeds.detail: See TC-security-4. wrapper_call() takes node.args[1:] for git-args and program-args. A fix reads a Starred or a non-constant first argument as opaque.

seeds.title: Process module reached through a class attribute and self
seeds.detail: See TC-security-8. An import in a class body used as self.sp.run escapes. Make any import inside a class body a dynamic entry, or resolve an Attribute call on self or cls.

seeds.title: os.startfile and other process starters are not in is_process()
seeds.detail: Open since r2. Add os.startfile, or ban every os.* call outside a short allowed list.

seeds.title: Dangling symlink or unreadable file crashes push_guard.py
seeds.detail: main() catches SyntaxError, UnicodeDecodeError and ValueError only. OSError gives a traceback and exit 1. The test fails closed, but the spec says a symlink is opaque.

seeds.title: Sets de-duplicate an identical second call
seeds.detail: pushes, direct and opaque are sorted sets. A second identical push line in the same function leaves every key equal. This is S1 territory.

seeds.title: Indentation is not part of the body pin
seeds.detail: body_text() drops INDENT, DEDENT and NEWLINE tokens. Moving a statement out of an if block keeps the pin. No push results because callers supply the verb. Seed only.

seeds.title: Store of a wrapper name is not recorded
seeds.detail: git = lambda ... or run = _other leaves every pin equal. A new process call in the target still changes direct. Seed only (S1).

seeds.title: testkit: no Python 3.11 or 3.12 on this host
seeds.detail: The body_text f-string and t-string parity claim was tested on 3.14.7 only.
